options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct analytical application of NCERT principle.

solution.quick: Option (D) is correct: Selling Concept vs Societal Marketing Concept
solution.concept: NCERT Class 12 Marketing Management: Selling Concept vs Societal Marketing Concept.
solution.detailed: The case narrative directly illustrates Selling Concept vs Societal Marketing Concept, analyzing its strategic role in customer satisfaction and commercial viability.
